arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَروًا
transliteration: Waalththariyati tharwan
translation: By those that winnow with a winnowing

arabic: فَالحٰمِلٰتِ وِقرًا
transliteration: Faalhamilati wiqran
translation: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

arabic: فَالجٰرِيٰتِ يُسرًا
transliteration: Faaljariyati yusran
translation: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

arabic: فَالمُقَسِّمٰتِ أَمرًا
transliteration: Faalmuqassimati amran
translation: And those who distribute (blessings) by command

arabic: إِنَّما توعَدونَ لَصادِقٌ
transliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun
translation: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true

arabic: وَإِنَّ الدّينَ لَوٰقِعٌ
transliteration: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun
translation: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall

arabic: وَالسَّماءِ ذاتِ الحُبُكِ
transliteration: Waalssamai thati alhubuki
translation: By the heaven full of paths

arabic: إِنَّكُم لَفى قَولٍ مُختَلِفٍ
transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
translation: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth)

arabic: يُؤفَكُ عَنهُ مَن أُفِكَ
transliteration: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika
translation: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse

arabic: قُتِلَ الخَرّٰصونَ
transliteration: Qutila alkharrasoona
translation: Accursed be the conjecturers

arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى غَمرَةٍ ساهونَ
transliteration: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
translation: Who are careless in an abyss

arabic: يَسـَٔلونَ أَيّانَ يَومُ الدّينِ
transliteration: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
translation: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment

arabic: يَومَ هُم عَلَى النّارِ يُفتَنونَ
transliteration: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona
translation: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire

arabic: ذوقوا فِتنَتَكُم هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تَستَعجِلونَ
transliteration: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona
translation: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten

arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
translation: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings

arabic: ءاخِذينَ ما ءاتىٰهُم رَبُّهُم إِنَّهُم كانوا قَبلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحسِنينَ
transliteration: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
translation: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good

arabic: كانوا قَليلًا مِنَ الَّيلِ ما يَهجَعونَ
transliteration: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona
translation: They used to sleep but little of the night

arabic: وَبِالأَسحارِ هُم يَستَغفِرونَ
transliteration: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
translation: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness

arabic: وَفى أَموٰلِهِم حَقٌّ لِلسّائِلِ وَالمَحرومِ
transliteration: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
translation: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share

arabic: وَفِى الأَرضِ ءايٰتٌ لِلموقِنينَ
transliteration: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
translation: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure

arabic: وَفى أَنفُسِكُم أَفَلا تُبصِرونَ
transliteration: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
translation: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see

arabic: وَفِى السَّماءِ رِزقُكُم وَما توعَدونَ
transliteration: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona
translation: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised

arabic: فَوَرَبِّ السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثلَ ما أَنَّكُم تَنطِقونَ
transliteration: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
translation: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak

arabic: هَل أَتىٰكَ حَديثُ ضَيفِ إِبرٰهيمَ المُكرَمينَ
transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
translation: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)

arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلَيهِ فَقالوا سَلٰمًا قالَ سَلٰمٌ قَومٌ مُنكَرونَ
transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
translation: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me)

arabic: فَراغَ إِلىٰ أَهلِهِ فَجاءَ بِعِجلٍ سَمينٍ
transliteration: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin
translation: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf

arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيهِم قالَ أَلا تَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
translation: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat

arabic: فَأَوجَسَ مِنهُم خيفَةً قالوا لا تَخَف وَبَشَّروهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَليمٍ
transliteration: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin
translation: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son

arabic: فَأَقبَلَتِ امرَأَتُهُ فى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّت وَجهَها وَقالَت عَجوزٌ عَقيمٌ
transliteration: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun
translation: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman

arabic: قالوا كَذٰلِكِ قالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الحَكيمُ العَليمُ
transliteration: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
translation: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower

arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكُم أَيُّهَا المُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
translation: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)

arabic: قالوا إِنّا أُرسِلنا إِلىٰ قَومٍ مُجرِمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
translation: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk

arabic: لِنُرسِلَ عَلَيهِم حِجارَةً مِن طينٍ
transliteration: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin
translation: That we may send upon them stones of clay

arabic: مُسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلمُسرِفينَ
transliteration: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena
translation: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton

arabic: فَأَخرَجنا مَن كانَ فيها مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
translation: Then we brought forth such believers as were there

arabic: فَما وَجَدنا فيها غَيرَ بَيتٍ مِنَ المُسلِمينَ
transliteration: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
translation: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah)

arabic: وَتَرَكنا فيها ءايَةً لِلَّذينَ يَخافونَ العَذابَ الأَليمَ
transliteration: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema
translation: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom

arabic: وَفى موسىٰ إِذ أَرسَلنٰهُ إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin
translation: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant

arabic: فَتَوَلّىٰ بِرُكنِهِ وَقالَ سٰحِرٌ أَو مَجنونٌ
transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
translation: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman

arabic: فَأَخَذنٰهُ وَجُنودَهُ فَنَبَذنٰهُم فِى اليَمِّ وَهُوَ مُليمٌ
transliteration: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
translation: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate

arabic: وَفى عادٍ إِذ أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِمُ الرّيحَ العَقيمَ
transliteration: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema
translation: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them

arabic: ما تَذَرُ مِن شَيءٍ أَتَت عَلَيهِ إِلّا جَعَلَتهُ كَالرَّميمِ
transliteration: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi
translation: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust

arabic: وَفى ثَمودَ إِذ قيلَ لَهُم تَمَتَّعوا حَتّىٰ حينٍ
transliteration: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin
translation: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile

arabic: فَعَتَوا عَن أَمرِ رَبِّهِم فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُم يَنظُرونَ
transliteration: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona
translation: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed

arabic: فَمَا استَطٰعوا مِن قِيامٍ وَما كانوا مُنتَصِرينَ
transliteration: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
translation: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves

arabic: وَقَومَ نوحٍ مِن قَبلُ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومًا فٰسِقينَ
transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
translation: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk

arabic: وَالسَّماءَ بَنَينٰها بِأَيي۟دٍ وَإِنّا لَموسِعونَ
transliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
translation: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof)

arabic: وَالأَرضَ فَرَشنٰها فَنِعمَ المٰهِدونَ
transliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona
translation: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)

arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ خَلَقنا زَوجَينِ لَعَلَّكُم تَذَكَّرونَ
transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona
translation: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect

arabic: فَفِرّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنّى لَكُم مِنهُ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
translation: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him

arabic: وَلا تَجعَلوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ إِنّى لَكُم مِنهُ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
translation: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ ما أَتَى الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا قالوا ساحِرٌ أَو مَجنونٌ
transliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
translation: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman

arabic: أَتَواصَوا بِهِ بَل هُم قَومٌ طاغونَ
transliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
translation: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنهُم فَما أَنتَ بِمَلومٍ
transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin
translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy

arabic: وَذَكِّر فَإِنَّ الذِّكرىٰ تَنفَعُ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena
translation: And warn, for warning profiteth believers

arabic: وَما خَلَقتُ الجِنَّ وَالإِنسَ إِلّا لِيَعبُدونِ
transliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni
translation: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me

arabic: ما أُريدُ مِنهُم مِن رِزقٍ وَما أُريدُ أَن يُطعِمونِ
transliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni
translation: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزّاقُ ذُو القُوَّةِ المَتينُ
transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
translation: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might

arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ذَنوبًا مِثلَ ذَنوبِ أَصحٰبِهِم فَلا يَستَعجِلونِ
transliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona
translation: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day)

arabic: فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن يَومِهِمُ الَّذى يوعَدونَ
transliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
translation: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised
